f: F is a degree on the Fahrenheit scale of temperature.
F can also mean a nonmetallic univalent element belonging to the halogens.
F can also mean the capacitance of a capacitor that has an equal and opposite charge of 1 coulomb on each plate and a voltage difference of 1 volt between the plates.
F means the same as degree Fahrenheit or fluorine or atomic number 9.
f. d. roosevelt: F. D. Roosevelt is 32nd President of the United States.
F. D. Roosevelt means the same as Roosevelt or Franklin Roosevelt or Franklin Delano Roosevelt.
f. g. banting: F. G. Banting is Canadian physiologist who discovered insulin with C. H. Best and who used it to treat diabetes.
F. G. Banting means the same as Banting or Sir Frederick Grant Banting.
f. scott fitzgerald: F. Scott Fitzgerald is United States author whose novels characterized the Jazz Age in the United States.
F. Scott Fitzgerald means the same as Fitzgerald or Francis Scott Key Fitzgerald.
F.I.S.C. is a secret federal court created in 1978 by the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act.
F.I.S.C. means the same as Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Court.
f clef: F clef is a clef that puts the F below middle C on the fourth line of a staff.
F clef means the same as bass clef.
f layer: F layer is the highest region of the ionosphere which contains the highest concentration of free electrons and is most useful for long-range radio transmission.
F layer means the same as Appleton layer or F region.
f number: A f number is the ratio of the focal length to the diameter of a lens system.
F number means the same as focal ratio or stop number or speed.
f region: F region is the highest region of the ionosphere which contains the highest concentration of free electrons and is most useful for long-range radio transmission.
F region means the same as Appleton layer or F layer.
